Distribution range and habitat preference. All known specimens are from the northeastern part of Fars Province. The Sepidan Mountain Pass is about 8 km north of Ardakan. The Komehr – Ardakan pass is about 10 km northeast of Ardakan. Kaftar Lake is 20 km south of Eqlid and about 80 km northeast of Ardakan. Two paratypes of the Komehr – Ardakan Pass have been collected under stones in a dry vegetation without grass at the highest elevations of the mountains (Fig. 4 a). So far, no captures at light are known.
